structure: Part 6 covers the end of Appendix B 'Problems, Questions, and Themes in the History and Geography Classroom' (book pp. 659-691): the seven Key Themes (narrative essays each ending with a '* * * * *' summary), with running header/footer lines kept as units. Appendix B states the themes and sample questions are for grades five through eight and ten and eleven, so they are labeled examples with those grades. Appendix C (standards) begins right after u6771.

issues: u6536-u6771: Appendix B themes are not tied to one grade; grades '5-8,10,11' taken from the intro statement (u6519) that sample questions pertain to those grades. The sample question lists mentioned in u6519 do not appear in this extracted range.
u6541,u6550,u6557 etc: page-footer lines (e.g. 'Appendix B | California History-Social Science Framework') and repeated page-header lines remain as units and are labeled with the surrounding section.
